name: plushie
description: A plush Clawd above the prompt that reacts to what Claude is doing: works, celebrates, wobbles, blushes, naps, and can be patted and dragged.

drag.title: Drag Clawd
drag.description: Press on Clawd and drag it along the band above the prompt; it dangles while held and lands where you let go.

pats.title: Pat Clawd
pats.description: A click on Clawd without dragging pats it: a squish, a happy squint and hearts.

toolProps.title: Tool props
toolProps.description: Clawd holds a prop for the tool Claude is using: a magnifier to read or search, knitting needles to edit, a keyboard for the shell, binoculars for the web.

miniClawds.title: Mini Clawds
miniClawds.description: Each running subagent gets a half-size Clawd beside the main one; it walks off when the subagent finishes.

stuffing.title: Stuffed by context
stuffing.description: Clawd grows rounder as the context window fills and deflates with a sigh when it is compacted.

blush.title: Blush at kind words
blush.description: Thanks or praise in a prompt makes Clawd blush.

fidgets.title: Idle fidgets
fidgets.description: Left alone, Clawd now and then looks around, scratches, yawns or hops.

sounds.title: Sound effects
sounds.description: Little sounds for pats, jumps, wobbles, blushes, being picked up and put down, deflating and dozing off.
